entries.title: Narrator: "You rose to your feet as the bright..."
entries.dialogueText: You rose to your feet as the bright light enveloped you.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "The only thing you could do was to..."
entries.dialogueText: The only thing you could do was to look away.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "What had started as a rumble in the..."
entries.dialogueText: What had started as a rumble in the distance was now a deafening roar.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "It took all of your strength and co..."
entries.dialogueText: It took all of your strength and courage to rise to your feet again.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A mushroom-shaped cloud many skyscr..."
entries.dialogueText: A mushroom-shaped cloud many skyscrapers tall was towering above Holsord.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "You barely registered the shockwave..."
entries.dialogueText: You barely registered the shockwave as the wall of extreme heat and pressure destroyed everything in its path.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "You couldn't believe what you were..."
entries.dialogueText: You couldn't believe what you were seeing.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "It was the last thing you saw."
entries.dialogueText: It was the last thing you saw.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "You closed your ears and crouched d..."
entries.dialogueText: You closed your ears and crouched down.
